# Read-Only B-Tree Cursor Compatibility Fixture

These artifacts were generated by the pinned SQLite command-line shell:

```text
3.54.0 2026-10-02 20:18:07 65ec11f05a9ee5b23495427ece76c0550a8ffc28980a8a0c72d556ba0d2290e2
```

The database uses 512-byte pages, DELETE journal mode, application ID
`1297305932`, and user version `17`. It contains 166 rows and passed the
pinned shell's `PRAGMA integrity_check`.

## Page layout

| Object | Root page | Internal pages | Leaf pages | Overflow pages |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `cursor_sample` | 2 | 1 | 55 | 18 |
| `idx_binary` | 76 | 1 | 5 | 0 |
| `idx_nocase_desc` | 82 | 1 | 5 | 0 |
| `idx_rtrim` | 89 | 1 | 5 | 0 |
| `idx_mixed` | 96 | 1 | 5 | 0 |
| `idx_overflow` | 102 | 1 | 6 | 12 |

The database has 120 pages. The table contains negative, zero, ordinary,
32-bit-boundary-crossing, and signed-64-bit-boundary rowids. Row 44 has a
3000-byte table payload. Rows 42 and 43 have 3000-byte index keys backed by
overflow pages.

The indexes exercise:

- duplicate BINARY keys;
- duplicate NOCASE keys in descending order;
- duplicate RTRIM keys with zero, one, and two trailing spaces;
- descending nullable integers followed by ascending text; and
- local and overflow-backed index records.

`PRAGMA index_xinfo` reports the implicit rowid tail as BINARY ascending for
all five indexes.

## Generation SQL

```sql
PRAGMA page_size=512;
PRAGMA auto_vacuum=NONE;
VACUUM;
PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE;
PRAGMA application_id=1297305932;
PRAGMA user_version=17;

CREATE TABLE cursor_sample(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  binary_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  nocase_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  rtrim_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  descending_key INTEGER,
  overflow_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload BLOB NOT NULL
);

WITH RECURSIVE sequence(value) AS (
  VALUES(1)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT value + 1 FROM sequence WHERE value < 160
)
INSERT INTO cursor_sample(
  id,
  binary_key,
  nocase_key,
  rtrim_key,
  descending_key,
  overflow_key,
  payload
)
SELECT value,
       printf('bin-%02d', value % 13),
       (CASE value % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'Case' WHEN 1 THEN 'case' ELSE 'CASE' END)
         || printf('-%02d', value % 7),
       printf('pad-%02d', value % 9) || substr('   ', 1, value % 3),
       CASE WHEN value % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE value % 5 END,
       printf('over-%03d', value % 17),
       CAST(printf('payload-%04d-', value) || hex(zeroblob(48)) AS BLOB)
FROM sequence;

INSERT INTO cursor_sample VALUES
  (-9223372036854775808, 'bin-min', 'Minimum', 'minimum  ', NULL, 'over-min', X'6d696e'),
  (-1000, 'bin-neg', 'Negative', 'negative ', -3, 'over-neg', X'6e6567'),
  (-1, 'bin-neg', 'NEGATIVE', 'negative', -1, 'over-neg', X'6d696e757331'),
  (0, 'bin-zero', 'Zero', 'zero  ', 0, 'over-zero', X'7a65726f'),
  (2147483648, 'bin-high', 'High', 'high ', 7, 'over-high', X'68696768'),
  (9223372036854775807, 'bin-max', 'Maximum', 'maximum  ', NULL, 'over-max', X'6d6178');

UPDATE cursor_sample
SET overflow_key = replace(hex(zeroblob(1500)), '0', 'm')
WHERE id = 42;

UPDATE cursor_sample
SET overflow_key = replace(hex(zeroblob(1500)), '0', 'n')
WHERE id = 43;

UPDATE cursor_sample
SET payload = zeroblob(3000)
WHERE id = 44;

CREATE INDEX idx_binary ON cursor_sample(binary_key);
CREATE INDEX idx_nocase_desc
  ON cursor_sample(nocase_key COLLATE NOCASE DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_rtrim
  ON cursor_sample(rtrim_key COLLATE RTRIM);
CREATE INDEX idx_mixed
  ON cursor_sample(descending_key DESC, binary_key ASC);
CREATE INDEX idx_overflow
  ON cursor_sample(overflow_key);
```

## Expected traversal artifacts

Each `*-rowids.txt` file contains the rowids emitted by a forward scan of the
named B-tree, one signed decimal value per line. Index scans were forced with
`INDEXED BY`; the table scan was forced with `NOT INDEXED`. A reverse cursor
scan must equal the reverse of the corresponding file.
